title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Duke University
description: Navigate Durham after dark with these essential late-night destinations, from on-campus study hubs to iconic off-campus eateries that define the Duke student experience.

cards.title: Cosmic Cantina
cards.subtitle: Ninth Street District
cards.notes: Climb the stairs to this Ninth Street staple for burritos and quesadillas. It is a primary late-night destination for students, remaining open until 4:00 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing Mexican eatery on Ninth Street known for its late-night hours and rooftop patio.
cards.evidence_claim: Cosmic Cantina is open until 4:00 AM every day and is a popular late-night spot for students.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 11:00 AM to 4:00 AM.

cards.title: Pitchfork's
cards.subtitle: McClendon Tower
cards.notes: Located in McClendon Tower, this campus cafe serves breakfast all day and late-night meals, often operating until 3:00 AM for students on West Campus.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining location in McClendon Tower offering late-night food options and 24/7 access during peak periods.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitchfork's is a late-night dining option on campus, often cited as being open until 3:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Typically open late night until 3:00 AM during academic terms.

cards.title: Waffle House
cards.subtitle: Ninth Street
cards.notes: A reliable 24-hour spot on Ninth Street for breakfast classics. It serves as a quiet study alternative or a post-library meal destination for the Duke community.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner located on Ninth Street near East Campus, popular for late-night breakfast.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waffle House on Ninth Street is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Cook Out
cards.subtitle: Shannon Road
cards.notes: Drive to this North Carolina classic for milkshakes and trays. The Shannon Road location is a frequent late-night stop, closing at 3:00 AM or later.
cards.short_summary: A regional fast-food chain famous for its extensive milkshake menu and late-night 'trays'.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Out locations in Durham typically close between 3:00 AM and 4:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 4:00 AM Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Perkins Library
cards.subtitle: West Campus
cards.notes: The primary research library on West Campus. During the academic year, it offers extended hours, often remaining open until midnight or later for student study.
cards.short_summary: Duke's main library, providing late-night study spaces and resources for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins Library offers extended hours until midnight or 3:00 AM during peak academic periods.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by term; typically open until midnight or 3:00 AM Sunday-Thursday during semesters.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Bryan Center
cards.notes: Conveniently located in the Bryan Center on West Campus, this McDonald's provides a familiar late-night food option for students studying nearby.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus McDonald's located in the Bryan Center, serving students late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bryan Center McDonald's is a designated late-night dining option on the Duke campus.
cards.access_notes: Open late; check current campus dining hours for specific closing times.

cards.title: Devil's Krafthouse
cards.subtitle: Brodhead Center
cards.notes: Located in the basement of the Brodhead Center, this venue offers a pub-style menu and is a popular late-night gathering spot, often open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A campus eatery in the Brodhead Center known for its late-night food and social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Devil's Krafthouse is open until midnight and serves a late-night menu.

cards.title: Loop Pizza Grill
cards.subtitle: Bryan Center
cards.notes: A West Campus favorite in the Bryan Center, serving pizza, burgers, and shakes. It remains open until midnight, catering to late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A casual dining spot on West Campus offering a variety of late-night food options until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Loop Pizza Grill at Duke University is open until 12:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Loop Pizza Grill - Duke University - Discover Durham
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 11:00 AM to 12:00 AM.

cards.title: Enzo's Pizza Co.
cards.subtitle: Erwin Road
cards.notes: Located near campus on Erwin Road, Enzo's is a go-to for late-night pizza delivery or carryout, with weekend hours extending until 11:00 PM or later.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza shop near Duke's West Campus popular for its specialty pies and late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Enzo's Pizza Co. on Erwin Road is open until 11:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Sun-Thu and 11:00 PM Fri-Sat.

cards.title: The Perk
cards.subtitle: Perkins Library
cards.notes: Commonly known as 'The Perk,' this glass-walled pavilion attached to Perkins Library offers late-night study space and coffee during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A popular sunlit study space and cafe attached to Perkins Library that stays open late for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The von der Heyden Pavilion (The Perk) offers extended study hours until 3:00 AM during the semester.
cards.access_notes: Extended hours until 3:00 AM Sunday-Thursday during the academic semester.
